blockers.description: No M6B candidate source and blind pool identity is frozen.
blockers.required_decision_or_change: Choose exactly one reviewed candidate source, count, seed semantic, and pre-outcome manifest.
blockers.workaround_risk: Ad-hoc candidates invalidate blindness and paired evidence.

blockers.description: ACT queue, processor history, and episode-prefix state have no serialized inference snapshot.
blockers.required_decision_or_change: Serialize complete policy state or freeze an initial-state-only smoke that never claims intermediate same-policy continuation.
blockers.workaround_risk: Resetting policy state at an intermediate simulator state changes deployed behavior.

blockers.description: No compact deployable LangMani verifier vector is frozen.
blockers.required_decision_or_change: Freeze a minimal field allowlist with no task target index, outcome, candidate provenance, or reporting metadata.
blockers.workaround_risk: Concatenating all fields leaks privileged task and outcome information.

blockers.description: Intermediate state round trips are audited, but accepted paired action execution from restored intermediate states is absent.
blockers.required_decision_or_change: Validate complete intermediate paired replay or limit M6B to verified seeded initial resets.
blockers.workaround_risk: Calling restore audit exact replay would overstate physical evidence.

blockers.description: LatentGuard and LangMani dependency pins are incompatible in one Python environment.
blockers.required_decision_or_change: Validate canonical JSON interchange between the unchanged environments.
blockers.workaround_risk: Forcing a shared NumPy/Python version can invalidate accepted environments.

blockers.description: M6B has not frozen one task and its exact accepted checkpoint registry entry.
blockers.required_decision_or_change: Choose one canonical task and bind its checkpoint/model/processor/runtime identities before source seeds or outcomes exist.
blockers.workaround_risk: Post-outcome task or checkpoint choice creates selection leakage.
